description: Group C field family: ece (Expected Calibration Error) over 15 equal-width confidence bins [0,1/15), ..., [14/15,1]. Per bin: |mean_confidence - accuracy| weighted by bin_count/N, summed across non-empty bins.

input.pair_format: [confidence, correct_flag] where correct_flag is 1 if the prediction was correct, 0 otherwise
